rule: Each row has exactly one primary evidence class: PARENT_THEOREM, FORMAL_TARGET, FINITE_EXACT_TARGET, EMPIRICAL_CONJECTURE, or IMPOSSIBILITY_BOUNDARY.

rows.statement: Representational universality alone cannot establish an intelligence-specific morphology theory; a universal simulator may reproduce every target while making no nontrivial ecology-conditioned resource or developmental prediction.
rows.falsifier_or_attack: Show that the proposed intelligence-specific result follows solely from universal simulation with no additional assumptions; then Track B collapses to UNIVERSAL_COMPUTATION_ONLY.

rows.statement: Under No-Free-Lunch assumptions, no optimizer/morphology can be universally superior over the unrestricted closed problem class.
rows.consequence: All phase/superiority claims must be ecology-relative.

rows.statement: Broad neural function classes have universal approximation results, and recurrent neural systems can simulate Turing computation under established constructions.
rows.consequence: Neural representability/universality is not evidence that neural morphology is uniquely fundamental or practically favored.

rows.statement: Symmetric developmental compilation with identical registered tolerances and bounded resource inflation defines an equivalence relation after quotienting compiler identities that induce the same semantics.
assumptions: resource-bound composition is transitive under a declared bound-composition rule
rows.falsifier_or_attack: Construct non-transitivity under the current tolerance/resource definition; revise the relation to a preorder/category rather than forcing equivalence.

rows.statement: Current-behavior equivalence does not imply developmental equivalence.
rows.witness_plan: Construct two finite machines with identical truth table/policy before experience but distinct registered update rules; after one training event their outputs diverge.

rows.statement: Multiple syntactically distinct minimal generating bases can generate the same bounded transformation class with different compilation depths/costs.
rows.witness: Boolean census in this capsule: NAND and NOR are singleton complete bases; NOT+AND and NOT+OR are two-primitive complete bases for all binary Boolean functions under the registered composition model.
rows.claim_boundary: Known Boolean functional-completeness calibration only; not an intelligence result.

rows.statement: Feedforward neural computation can be compiled from a sufficiently expressive typed transducer/compositional-learner basis using affine aggregation plus nonlinearity; a gradient-style update can be represented as a developmental update when the basis exposes differentiable parameter state.
rows.required_residual: bounded overhead and no hidden neural macro in the basis

rows.statement: Production/rewrite systems can be compiled from the same candidate basis without adding an architecture-labelled production primitive.
rows.required_residual: typed condition/action behavior plus update semantics with bounded overhead

rows.statement: Probabilistic generative/inference morphologies can be compiled from the same candidate basis, or the failure supplies a principled need for stochastic primitives.
rows.falsifier_or_attack: If stochastic semantics are merely smuggled in as an arbitrary black-box primitive, the derivation does not count.

rows.statement: Programmatic/library-learning morphologies can be compiled from the same candidate basis with bounded execution and update overhead.
There exist measurable ecology coordinates for which the nondominated morphology frontier changes systematically between at least two non-equivalent morphology classes.
rows.required_evidence: prospective phase prediction + blind search on protected/disjoint ecologies + search-encoding controls

rows.statement: Mixed statistical + exact compositional ecologies can create a Pareto region where a hybrid morphology is not developmentally/resource-equivalent to either registered pure parent at matched capability.
No finite set of successful morphology searches can establish universal superiority or prove unbounded future morphology novelty without additional formal assumptions.
rows.consequence: All new-form/open-ended conclusions remain horizon/scope bounded.
